# Honeywell Hydraulics

> Industrial hydraulic cylinders, custom hydraulic power packs, and precision CNC-machined manifold blocks manufactured in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. ISO 9001:2015 certified OEM manufacturer serving 25+ heavy industrial sectors and 18 major industrial corridors across India.

## Company Overview
Honeywell Hydraulics (est. 2018) is a precision fluid power manufacturer headquartered in Kathwada GIDC, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. We engineer, manufacture, and test heavy-duty hydraulic equipment for continuous high-cycle operations in plastics, steel, construction, material handling, automotive, and industrial machinery sectors.

- **Primary Website:** https://honeywellhydraulics.in
- **Certification:** ISO 9001:2015 Certified
- **Factory Address:** B-18, Suryam Plaza Estate, Near Nilkanth Estate, Road no. 15, Kathwada GIDC, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382430, India
- **Coordinates:** 23.035° N, 72.668° E
- **Direct Phone:** +91 99243 43873
- **Sales Email:** sales@honeywellhydraulics.com
- **Operating Hours:** Monday – Saturday, 09:00 – 19:00 IST

## Core Product Portfolio & Technical Specifications

### 1. Hydraulic Cylinders (Bore: 40mm to 500mm | Stroke: up to 6,000mm | Pressure: up to 700 Bar)
- **Custom Hydraulic Cylinders:** Application-tailored bore/stroke geometries with custom porting, cushioning, and heavy-duty load capacities.
- **Double Acting Hydraulic Cylinders:** Powered extension and retraction for metal forming, presses, and high-repetition cycle automation (up to 350 Bar).
- **Single Acting Hydraulic Cylinders:** Gravity or spring-return single-stroke actuators for tippers, clamps, and lifting fixtures (up to 250 Bar).
- **Telescopic Hydraulic Cylinders:** Multi-stage (2 to 5 stage) nested chrome stages for long extension in compact retracted footprints (tipping trailers, high-reach platforms).
- **Tie-Rod Hydraulic Cylinders:** NFPA standard interchangeability, high tensile tie-rods for injection moulding and machine tooling (up to 160 Bar).
- **Welded Hydraulic Cylinders:** Heavy-wall welded construction, forged end caps for earthmoving, construction equipment, and high-vibration applications (up to 350 Bar).
- **Goods Lift & Car Parking Cylinders:** High-safety dual-seal hydraulic rams for warehouse freight lifts and automated multi-level puzzle parking.
- **Scissor Lift Table Cylinders:** Heavy-thrust compact actuators with built-in velocity fuses for ergonomic assembly lifting tables.
- **Specialized Mounting Types:** Front/Rear Flange (ISO 6022), Clevis (pivoting clevis pins), Trunnion (intermediate/head/cap pivot), and Square Body Industrial Jacks.

### 2. Hydraulic Power Packs (Motor: 0.5 HP to 75 HP | Tank: 10L to 2,000L | Pressure: up to 450 Bar)
- **Three-Phase Hydraulic Power Packs:** 415V continuous duty power units with immersed/external gear or piston pumps for 24/7 plant production lines.
- **Single-Phase Hydraulic Power Packs:** 220V compact hydraulic power units for small workshop machinery, auto garage lifts, and mobile units.
- **High-Low Dual Pump Power Packs:** High-flow low-pressure rapid approach paired with low-flow high-pressure clamping (cycle time reduction up to 20%).
- **Hydraulic Power Packs for Hydraulic Presses:** High-tonnage fluid units for 50T to 1,000T deep-drawing, compression moulding, and forging presses.
- **Multi-Station Solenoid Power Packs:** Centralized multi-valve manifold assemblies for synchronized sequencing of multiple hydraulic cylinders.
- **Accumulator Power Packs:** Bladder/piston hydraulic energy storage units for instantaneous peak flow discharge and fail-safe emergency backup.
- **Hand-Lever & Hand-Pump Power Units:** Rugged manual directional valve and zero-power manual backup pumping stations for field machinery.
- **Custom Engineered Power Packs:** Tailored reservoirs, fluid filtration (10-micron return), air/water oil coolers, and PLC/electric control panels.

### 3. Hydraulic Manifold Blocks (NG6 / CETOP 3 to NG32 / CETOP 10)
- **06-Size (CETOP 03 / NG6 / D03) Manifold Blocks:** Precision-drilled subplates and parallel circuits for compact valve stacks (up to 315 Bar).
- **10-Size (CETOP 05 / NG10 / D05) Manifold Blocks:** High-flow ductile iron/steel manifold blocks for heavy industrial circuits (up to 350 Bar).
- **CETOP Modular Manifold Blocks:** ISO 4401 compliant sandwich and subplate blocks for modular circuit stacking.
- **Custom CNC-Machined Manifolds:** In-house 4-axis CNC machined complex integrated logic blocks with Sun, HydraForce, and Rexroth cavity tooling.
- **Multi-Station Parallel Manifold Blocks:** 2 to 10 station monolithic blocks eliminating external hydraulic piping and preventing leak paths.

---

## Manufacturing & Quality Infrastructure (E-E-A-T)

- **CNC Machining Center:** High-precision VMC and CNC turning lathes guarantee bore tolerances within H8/H9 and surface roughness Ra < 0.2 µm.
- **Hard Chrome Plating:** Piston rods induction hardened and hard chrome plated (minimum 25–30 microns thickness, corrosion resistance 96 hrs salt spray).
- **Seal Packaging:** Standard polyurethane (PU), Viton (FKM for high temperatures), and PTFE step seals sourced from Parker, Hallite, and Merkel.
- **Hydrostatic Test Rig:** 100% of manufactured cylinders, manifolds, and power packs undergo hydrostatic pressure testing at 1.5× rated working pressure prior to dispatch.
- **Material Traceability:** EN 10204 Type 3.1 test certificates provided for ST52, EN8, EN19, EN24, and SS316 raw materials.
- **Delivery Lead Times:** Standard items dispatched in 7–10 days; fully custom-engineered systems within 15–20 days.

## Geographical Service Network (18 Key Industrial Corridors)

### Gujarat (Manufacturing Base & Key Hubs):
- **Ahmedabad:** Kathwada GIDC, Vatva, Odhav, Naroda, Changodar, Sanand
- **Surat:** Sachin, Hazira, Pandesara, Pipodara (Textile & Diamond Machinery)
- **Vadodara:** Makarpura, Savli, Waghodia, Por-Ramangamdi (Chemical & Heavy Engineering)
- **Rajkot:** Metoda GIDC, Aji, Shapar-Veraval (Machine Tools, Castings & Auto Parts)
- **Morbi:** Ceramic Tile Presses & Hydraulic Machinery
- **Vapi & Ankleshwar:** Chemical, Paper, and Pharmaceutical Process Machinery
- **Bhavnagar & Alang:** Marine Hydraulics & Heavy Ship-Breaking Shears
- **Jamnagar, Gandhinagar, Halol & Kutch:** Brass parts, Automotive OEMs, Ports & Logistics

### National Industrial Hubs:
- **Maharashtra:** Pune (Chakan / Bhosari / Pimpri), Mumbai, Nashik, Aurangabad
